dimensions.name: Relationship recovery under a prescribed specification
Relationship discovery from data alone
dimensions.justification: Feature importances only, no false-discovery control. Planted tasks: TPR 1.0, FDR 0.459, silent on 1/5 null tasks.

dimensions.name: Experimental iteration speed
dimensions.justification: Session median 0.58 s, p90 0.86 s per follow-up.

dimensions.name: Robustness across conditions
dimensions.justification: Completes 285/285 real runs; small-n median 0.8% below the reference. Large-n unmeasured.

dimensions.name: Uncertainty honesty (calibration)
dimensions.justification: reg:quantileerror intervals: median coverage 0.733, 91.5% of runs below 0.85; S3 terciles 0.646/0.686/0.666. Binary median ECE 0.053.

dimensions.name: Reproducibility and auditability
dimensions.justification: Identical on rerun 10/10; no decision trail.

dimensions.name: Predictive validity
dimensions.justification: Regression: beats the reference on 28/45, median gap to best 19.3%. Binary: median excess over the reference +10.8% (worse than the simple baseline on most tasks), gap to best 35.7%. Half point: useful on regression, fails the baseline on classification.
